instructions: Search and read Slack messages, files, users, channels, threads, and canvases. The available tools are forwarded 1:1 from Slack's native MCP server, filtered to read-only tools. Write tools (send message, create/update canvas, etc.) are not surfaced by this wrapper today; the `tools/list` filter is the single barrier.

tools.name: slack_search_public_and_private
tools.title: Search messages and files
tools.description: Searches for messages, files in ALL Slack channels, including public channels, private channels, DMs, and group DMs. Current logged in user's user_id is U0A5U4N

tools.name: slack_search_channels
tools.title: Search channels
tools.description: Search for Slack channels by name or description. Returns channel names, IDs, topics, purposes, and archive status.

tools.name: slack_search_users
tools.title: Search users
tools.description: Search for Slack users by name, email, or profile attributes (department, role, title).

tools.name: slack_read_channel
tools.title: Read channel messages
tools.description: Reads messages from a Slack channel in reverse chronological order (newest first). To read DM history, use a user_id as channel_id. Read-only.

tools.name: slack_read_thread
tools.title: Read thread messages
tools.description: Reads messages from a specific Slack thread (parent message + all replies). Read-only.

tools.name: slack_read_canvas
tools.title: Read a canvas
tools.description: Retrieves the markdown content and section ID mapping of a Slack Canvas document. Read-only.

tools.name: slack_read_user_profile
tools.title: Read user profile
tools.description: Retrieves detailed profile information for a Slack user: contact info, status, timezone, organization, and role. Read-only. Defaults to current user if user_id
